steps.text: The service conductor must call out Eyiba [3ce] and wait for the congregation to respond holy before he asks the congregation to repeat Psalm 51 after him. When reading the Psalm, service conduct  CCC Holy Saviour Parish 2017 - 17 - should read it slowly and allow the congregations to finish repeating after him line by line before he continues with another line. Eyiba [3ce] Psalm 51 1. Have mercy upon me, o God, according to thy loving kindness; according to the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions. 2. Wash me thoroughly from my iniquities and cleanse me from our sins. 3. For I acknowledge our transgressions and my sins are ever before me. 4. Against Thee, Thee only have I sinned and done these evils in thy sight, that thou mightest be justified when thou speaketh and be clear when thou judgeth. 5. Behold I was sharpened in iniquity and in sin did my mothers conceived me. 6. Behold thou desireth truth in the inward parts and in the hidden parts. Thou shall make me to know wisdom. 7. Purge me with the blood of Jesus and I shall be clean. Wash me and I shall be whiter than snow. 8. Make me to hear the joy and gladness that the bones which thou have broken may rejoice. 9. Hide thy face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities. 10. Create in me a clean heart o God and renew a right spirit within me. 11. Cast me not away from thy presence and take not thy Holy Spirit from me. 12. Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation and uphold me with thy free spirit. 13. Then I will teach transgressor thy ways and sinners shall be converted unto thee. 14. Deliver me from blood guiltiness o God. Thou God of my salvation and my tongues shall sing aloud of thy righteousness, 15. O Lord, open thou my lips and my mouths shall show forth thy praise. 16. For thou desireth not in sacrifice else would I give it. Thou delighted not in burnt offering.  CCC Holy Saviour Parish 2017 - 18 - 17. The sacrifice acceptable to God is a broken spirit, broken and a contrite heart. O God, thou will not despise. 18. Do good in thy pleasure unto me, build thou the walls of salvation around me. 19. Then shall thou be pleased with my prayer and supplication. And now I shall dance and sing a song of praise around thy Holy altar….Amen

steps.text: Jehovah [3ce] Deut. 28: 1 – 14 1. And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all His commandments which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth. 2. And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God. 3. This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it. 25. Save now we beseech thee; O Lord , O Lord we beseech thee, send now prosperity 26. Blessed be He that cometh in the name of the Lord, we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord. 27. God is the Lord, who hath showed us light, bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the house of the altar,  CCC Holy Saviour Parish 2017 - 56 - 28. Who remembered us in our low estate; for his mercy endureth forever 24. And hath redeemed us from our enemies; for his mercy endureth forever 25. Who giveth food to all flesh for his mercy endureth forever. 26. O gives thanks unto the God of heaven; for his mercy endureth forever Psalm 27 [Eliya 3ce] 1. One thing have we desired of the Lord, that will we seek after; that we may dwell in the house of the Lord all days of our life, to behold the beauty of the Lord and to inquire in His temple. 5. And now shall our head be lifted up above our enemies round about us: there will we offer in His tabernacle sacrifices of joy; we will sing yea; we will sing praise unto the Lord. 7. Amen

Give the King thy judgements, O God and thy righteousness unto the King's son. 2. He shall judge thy people with righteousness and thy poor with judgement. 3. The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills by the righteousness 4. He shall judge the poor of the people, He shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces our oppressor 5. They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure throughout all generations  CCC Holy Saviour Parish 2017 - 59 - 6. He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that waters the earth. 7. In His days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth. 8. Celestial church shall have dominion from sea to sea, and from river unto the end of the earth. 9. They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before Him, and His enemies shall lick the dust. 10. The Kings and of the isles shall bring presents: The kings shall offer gifts. 11. Yea, all kings shall fall bow down before Him: all nations shall serve Him 12. For He shall deliver the needy when they crieth; the poor also and he or she that has no helper: 13. He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy. 14. He shall redeem our souls from souls from deceit and violence; and precious shall our blood be in His sight. 15. And He shall live, unto us shall be given gold: prayer shall be made for Him continually; and daily shall He be praised. 16. There shall be a handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; our enemies shall be confounded, and we shall flourish like the grass of the earth. 17. His name shall endure for ever; the name of Celestial Church shall be continued as long as the sun: men and women shall be blessed in Him: all nations shall call Him blessed. 18. Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Celestial Church, who only doeth wondrous things. 19. And blessed be His glorious name for ever, and let the whole world be filled with His glory. Amen, Amen, Amen.

Special note: 1. 1: A Prophet [male] carry a male baby, while a prophetess [female] carry a female baby 2. The prophet or prophetess carrying the baby and the child are to be sanctified by the shepherd with holy water. 3. If no prophet is readily available to carry a male child, a male member will carry the baby, while a prophetess stays beside the child to prophesy. The earth is the Lord's and the fullness thereof the world and they that dwell therein. 2. For He hath founded it upon the saes and established it upon the floors. 3. Who shall ascend into the hill of the Lord? Or who shall stand in His is holy place? 4. He that hath clean hands and a pure hearth; who hath not lifted his soul to vanity, nor sworn deceitfully. 5. He shall receive the blessing from the Lord and righteousness from the God of his salvation. 6. We are the generation that seek Him that seek thy face, God of Celestial. 7. Lift up your heads o ye gates; and be lifted up O ye everlasting door; and the King of glory shall come in. 8. Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle. 9. Who is this King of Glory: The Lord of hosts; Jesus Christ, He is the King of glory. Amen Psalm 150 1. Praise ye the Lord. Praise God in His sanctuary: praise Him in the firmament of His power 2. Praise Him with the tumbrel and dance: praise Him with stringed instruments and organs. 5. Praise Him upon the low sounding cymbals: Praise Him upon the high sounding cymbals. 6. steps.text: Members according to their rank[starting from the shepherd] followed by the visitors give money to the baby by placing the money in the bowl or tray provided, they should pick one sugar then dip it  CCC Holy Saviour Parish 2017 - 77 - inside the remaining honey and salt then have a taste. They will also take of the fruit provided. Filling out: 1. The bowl carrier 2. The prophet or the prophetess carrying the baby 3. The bowl/tray containing gift money 4. Seven selected members 5. The choir 6. The congregation. When handing the child over to mother: 1. The mother will kneel down at the entrance of the church 2. The bowl containing water on the right side, the money on the left hand of the mother 3. The seven selected members that ushered in the baby will surround the mother. 4. The Shepherd will sprinkle holy water on her, without touching the mother; the Shepherd will make signs of the cross on her palms in the air 3ce. 5. The Shepherd will now take the child from the prophet/prophetess and hand over the baby to the mother. 6. Prayer by the seven members for protection, peace, long life, victory, blessing, light of God to remain with the child and the family. 7. The conductor of the service will say the closing prayer and grace. 8. Seven Halleluiah to the four corners of the world. Note: The sanctified water in the bowl and the seven half burnt candles are to be used for the baby. The seven half burnt candle are to be use for seven days, one to be lit each day where the child is placed i.e. where the child sleep. Little sanctified water to be mix with the baby's bathing water and for drinking of the baby for three months.  CCC Holy Saviour Parish 2017 - 78 - Important notice: Immediately after the service, seven anointed members to sanctify the church with seven candle sticks. The church wardens are to sanctify the baby's parent house with seven candle sticks before the return of the baby. Special notice: It is compulsory to name a child on the 8th day according to Celestial Church of Christ tenet. If it becomes impossible for whatever reason to present the baby for naming on the 8th day, a stick of candle shall be put inside a white cloth having seven crosses representing the child and shall be handed over to the prophet or prophetess. After the service, the baby should have a taste of the honey, salt and sugar used for the naming service wherever he or she may be on that very day.  CCC Holy Saviour Parish 2017 - 79 -

Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy loving kindness; according to the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions. 21. Wash me thoroughly from my iniquities and cleanse me from my sins. 22. For I acknowledge my transgressions and my sins are ever before me. 23. O God, thou will not despise. 37. Do good in thy pleasure unto me, build thou the walls of salvation around me. 38. Then shall thou be pleased with my prayer and supplication. And now I shall dance and sing a song of praise around thy Holy altar…Amen

steps.text: Marriage:  CCC Holy Saviour Parish 2017 - 90 - 1. Handing over of the Bride to the groom's father and mother by the Bride's father and mother: The Bride's father and mother shall say these words before handing over the Bride ‘‘ In view of the mutual love between your son and our daughter and according to all relevant marriage rites performed in respect of our daughter………..[names], we hand over our daughter to you, as wife to your son with assurance of God' blessing on them'' [Amen] 2. Bridegroom's parents shall receive the Bride with thanks saying ‘‘we thank you for the love you have shown to us giving your daughter to our son……… [Names] as wife. We also have assurance of God's blessing on them [Amen] 3. The Bridegroom's parent shall hand over the Bride and the Groom to the representatives of the church members [a male and a female] with the following words: ‘‘Elders of the church, we hand over this Bridegroom and the Bride to you for proper care and to be guided from all worldly temptations and for Holy Wedlock of the couple with honest and sincere love and complete peace of mind to the end of their life's'' 4. The elders will then proceed to hand over the bride and groom to officiating minister with these words: ‘‘Our minister, we present this bride and groom to you for your blessing before the Lord'' 5. The officiating minister will hold the Bride's hand facing the congregation and make this pronouncement: ‘‘Behold our daughter whom we know before as a maiden but she is now ready to be joined to her husband. Is there anybody here present who is against this holy matrimony? If there be any present let such person signifies his or her hand. [This pronouncement will be made three times] If there is no opposition, then these two have become independent and an authority unto themselves without any obstacle or hindrance from man'' May God bless their union [Amen] 6. The Bridegroom will then proceed to hold the bride's left hand with his right while still facing the congregation, and recite after the officiating minister: I …………groom' name] take you………..[Bride's name] as my wedded wife, to have and to  CCC Holy Saviour Parish 2017 - 91 - hold, to love and to cherish till death do us part, according to God's holy law, and to this I give you my truth. The Bride will likewise hold the groom on the right hand with her right hand and recite after the officiating minister: I …………bride's name] take you………..[groom's name] as my wedded wife, to have and to hold, to love and to cherish till death do us part, according to God's holy law, and to this I give you my truth. 7. The two rings which had been brought to the altar for sanctification shall be brought forward. 8. The groom shall then proceed to put the wedding ring on the bride's finger. He shall initially hold the ring while reciting the following words after the officiating minister: ‘‘with this ring I wed you, my body, I will honour you, and with my possession I will care for you in the name of Jesus Christ our Lord [Amen]. The Bride will do likewise and recite the same words as groom did. Through these proceedings, the Bestman and Chief Bridesmaid will stand behind the bride and the groom. When doing this, they shall face the Altar, after the this session, the bride and groom will go hand-in-hand to their wedding seats [sitting arrangement 1]

steps.text: ORDER OF SERVICE FOR BAPTISM Important Notice: 1. Participant must have completed one year as Celestial Church member before receiving the sacrament of Baptism 2. Shepherd should allow themselves to be pressurised into baptising a member that are not qualified. 3. Such member must be fully aware of the tenets of the church 4. Shepherd must have organised seminars for the new members on the word of God and the importance of Baptism. He must be able to identify fruits of the Holy Spirit in those to be baptised. 5. The Shepherd-in-charge must put into practise the teaching of the doctrines of the church 6. All Shepherds are warned against baptising a member that has not completed one year as a member of the church 7. Shepherd must be in spirit during the baptismal exercise 8. Before proceeding for baptism, the Shepherd must inspect the river or stream where baptismal exercise will take place. The stream or the river must not be too deep. 9. Only full time church worker from the rank of Assistant Evangelist upward are the only authorised ministers to carry out baptism of member 10. Female member must not put on transparent wears so as not to expose their body. Baptismal Exercise

All Shepherd, a senior member and two senior female members from each Parish all over the world to present at the washing of feet service which normally takes place on Saturday preceding the Passion Week at the International Headquarter. steps.text: The service conductor must shout out Eyiba [3ce] and wait for the congregation to respond holy before he asks the congregation to repeat Psalm 51 after him. When reading the Psalm, service conduct should read it slowly and allow the congregations to finish repeating after him line by line before he continues with another line. Eyiba [3ce] Psalm 51 1. Have mercy upon us, o God, according to thy loving kindness; according to the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out our transgressions. 2. Wash us thoroughly from our iniquities and cleanse us from our sins. 3. For we acknowledge our transgressions and our sins are ever before us. 4. Against Thee, Thee only have sinned and done these evils in thy sight, that thou mightest be justified when thou speaketh and be clear when thou judgeth. 5. Behold we were sharpened in iniquity and in sin did our mothers conceived us. 6. Behold thou desireth truth in the inward parts and in the hidden parts. Thou shall make us to know wisdom. 7. Purge us with the blood of Jesus and we shall be clean. Wash us and we shall be whiter than snow. 8. Make us to hear the joy and gladness that the bones which thou have broken may rejoice. 9. Hide thy face from our sins and blot out all our iniquities.  CCC Holy Saviour Parish 2017 - 142 - 10. Create in us a clean heart o God and renew a right spirit within us. 11. Cast us not away from thy presence and take not thy Holy Spirit from us. 12. Restore unto us the joy of thy salvation and uphold us with thy free spirit. 13. Then we will teach transgressor thy ways and sinners shall be converted unto thee. 14. Deliver us from blood guiltiness o God. Thou God of our salvation and our tongues shall sing aloud of thy righteousness, 15. Lord, open thou our lips and our mouths shall show forth thy praise. 16. For thou desireth not in sacrifice else would we give it. Thou desireth not in burnt offering. 17. The sacrifice acceptable to God is a broken spirit, broken and a contrite heart. O God, thou will not despise. 18. Do good in thy pleasure unto us, build thou the walls of salvation around us. 19. Then shall thou be pleased with our prayer and supplication. And now we shall dance and sing a song of praise around thy Holy altar…Amen

steps.text: Eliya [3ce] Psalm 118  CCC Holy Saviour Parish 2017 - 143 - Psalm 118 1. O gives thanks to the Lord: for He is good: His mercy endureth forever 2. Let Celestians now say, His mercy endureth forever 3. Let the congregation now say, that His mercy endureth forever 4. Let them that fear the Lord say, that His mercy endureth forever 5. We call upon the Lord in distress; the Lord answered us, and set us in a large place. 6. The Lord is on our side; we will not fear: what can man do unto us? 7. The Lord taketh our part with them that help us: therefore shall we see our desire upon them that hate us. 8. It is better to trust in God than to put confidence in man. 9. It is better to trust in God than to put confidence in princes 10. All nations compassed us about but in the name of the Lord, we will destroy them. 11. They compassed us about yea they compassed us about: but in the name of the Lord we will destroy them. 12. They compassed us about like bees; they are quenched as a fire of thorns for in the name our God we will destroy them. 13. Thou hast thrust sore at us that we might fall: but the Lord helped us. 14. The Lord is our strength and song, and is become our salvation. 15. The voice and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous, the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly 16. The right hand of the Lord is exalted: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly 17. We will not die, but live to declare the works of the Lord. 18. The Lord has chastened us sore, but He has not given us over to death. 19. Open to us the gates of righteousness, we will go into them, and we will praise the Lord. 20. This the gate of the Lord into which the righteous shall enter 21. We will praise thee for thou hast heard us and art become our salvation  CCC Holy Saviour Parish 2017 - 144 - 22. The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner. 23. This is the Lord's doing it is marvellous in our eyes 24. This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it. 25. Save now we beseech thee; O Lord , O Lord we beseech thee, send now prosperity 26. Blessed be He that cometh in the name of the Lord, we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord. 27. God is the Lord, who hath showed us light, bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the house of the altar, 28. Thou art our God, and we will praise thee; thou art our God we will exalt thee. 29. O gives thanks to the Lord; for He is good, for His mercy endureth forever. Amen
